blurb: Guests go on fishing trips offshore, nearshore, or inshore targeting species like Bluefin Tuna, Yellowfin Tuna, Dolphin (Mahi-mahi), White Marlin, Sailfish, Blue Marlin, Spanish mackerel, and Bluefish. Offshore trips offer the chance to catch large game fish. Nearshore trips start with catching small bait fish. Inshore trips are active and suitable for kids.
